text.en:
The Calasiao National High School in the Municipality of Calasiao, Province of Pangasinan, is
hereby converted into a comprehensive national high school to be known as the Calasiao Comprehensive
National High School. Said school shall offer general secondary curriculum, vocational curriculum and other
technological courses.

The amount of the one hundred fifty thousand pesos for the operation of the school shall be
charged to the appropriations authorized by Batas Pambansa Blg. 80 for the Ministry of Education and Culture
intended for new national schools. Thereafter, such sum as may be necessary for its operation and
maintenance shall be provided for in the annual General Appropriations Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: March 5, 1982
